sources.institution: The Ohio State University (University, Athletics, Wexner Medical Center/Health System)
sources.coverage_years: Salaries as of 9/30 and calendar-year earnings, 2021-2025 as XLSX (search tool since 2018, earlier years were in the tool)
sources.institutions_covered: Ohio State (all campuses, incl. medical center and athletics)
sources.update_frequency: salaries mid-October, earnings early January (data last updated 2/23/2026)
sources.size: Salaries 2025: 3.39 MB; Earnings 2025: 4.13 MB; ~45,000+ rows per year
sources.notes: Static XLSX links on the search page; HEAD confirmed 200. Field names from page help text; verify headers. Host sets Citrix bot cookies but did not block.

sources.coverage_years: base salary as of 12/31/2025 (current file only; prior years not linked)
sources.employees: all non-student employees (adjunct/early-retiree faculty show zero salary)
sources.notes: File path changes each year (sites/default/files/YYYY-MM/...), so re-scrape landing page for new link. Spreadsheet 'includes further detail' than HTML table.

sources.institution: 13 Ohio public universities (BGSU, Central State, Cleveland State, Kent State, Miami, Ohio U, Shawnee State, Ohio State, Akron, Cincinnati, Toledo, Wright State, Youngstown State)
sources.system: The Buckeye Institute (think tank) Higher Ed Salary database
sources.institutions_covered: 13 public universities (not NEOMED, not community colleges)
sources.blocker: Search form only, no bulk export; data stops at 2022.
sources.notes: Data obtained by public records requests to each university. UC lacks department 2019-2022; Shawnee lacks job titles 2019, 2021, 2022. Best multi-institution historical source for Ohio, could be worth a records request to Buckeye for the underlying files.

sources.system: Ohio Checkbook (Ohio Treasurer / Dept of Administrative Services)
sources.blocker: Tableau Public embed; direct CSV URL is behind an AWS WAF CAPTCHA, and the workbook looks stale (2022).
sources.notes: Published by profile 'ohiodas'. Could not confirm person-level detail without interacting with the dashboard. Ohio Checkbook also has a Colleges and Universities spending section (expenditures, not pay).

sources.institution: Miami University, Wright State, Sinclair CC and other Dayton/Butler-area employers
sources.system: Dayton Daily News / Journal-News I-Team Payroll Project (news)
sources.institutions_covered: regional public employers incl. Miami University
OSU, UC, Miami, BGSU etc. appear in state employee listing (sourced to Ohio Treasurer)
sources.blocker: Third-party, paginated search; no bulk download without account.
sources.notes: Suggests the Treasurer/Checkbook has university payroll data that is not exposed as a clean download.

gaps: No official multi-institution bulk file. Only Ohio State and Ohio University publish downloadable files. No published person-level pay found for University of Cincinnati, Miami, Kent State, BGSU, Toledo, Akron, Wright State, Cleveland State, Youngstown State, Shawnee State, Central State, NEOMED, or any of the 23 community colleges (all would need Ohio public records requests). Buckeye Institute covers 13 universities but only through 2022 and only via search form.
notes: Rated Ohio Checkbook Tableau as C because the CSV path hit a CAPTCHA wall and I did not interact further. Did not download bulk files (HEAD only). Searched for UC/Miami/Kent/BGSU/Toledo/Akron official salary pages; none found, only H-1B aggregators.
